name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Auerhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Auerhof is located in Ebbs, Tyrol. The property is managed as a traditional inn, providing catering and culinary services to its guests. The estate harmoniously combines agriculture with comfortable holiday apartment rentals. Visitors can savour authentic regional produce from the farm's own production. The convenient location in Ebbs allows for scenic excursions into nearby Kufstein and the Kaisergebirge region. Rooms and apartments are simply and functionally furnished.
